name: Chipata
summary: First-party English and Nyanja-language discovery evidenced Chipata City Council as the local land/planning authority and the Zambia Ministry NSDI ArcGIS cadastre as a national public parcel source. Direct anonymous metadata and bounded geometry requests succeeded; the exact point returned zero features, while a 10 km envelope returned 29 lots and three safe samples were retained.
queryAndRequestOutcome: All executed discovery queries and four direct ArcGIS GET requests are recorded in city-2952-chipata.json. The service layer is polygonal, source EPSG:32735, and exposes SDE.Lots.UPID as Plot ID. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe owner/title/address fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used.
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
Zero exact-point results are not evidence of citywide absence.
The 10 km envelope is not a citywide completeness test.
The source's ZILMIS provenance, legal semantics, update cadence and coverage outside the tested envelope remain unresolved.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; runtime readiness remains held pending serial review.

qualification.reason: Safe native-ID-plus-polygon evidence is available for independent serial review; no runtime adapter admission is made here.

uncertainty: The sample is bounded and may not represent all Chipata parcels. EPSG:4326 output geometry was retained for GeoJSON interoperability from an EPSG:32735 source layer.
